name: plugin.web_fetcher
description: Clean web page fetcher, automated HTML-to-Markdown distillation, and custom HTTP request client
author: Brain Harness Forge Engine

entrypoints.name: web_fetch_url
entrypoints.description: Fetch a remote web page by URL and return status, response headers, and raw text body

entrypoints.name: web_fetch_markdown
entrypoints.description: Fetch a URL and automatically distill HTML layout and styling into clean Markdown

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Target HTTP/HTTPS URL to convert to Markdown

entrypoints.name: web_http_request
entrypoints.description: Perform custom HTTP requests (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH) with custom headers and JSON payloads

parameters.name: method
parameters.description: HTTP method (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH - default: GET)

parameters.name: headers
parameters.description: Optional HTTP request header key-value pairs
